title: Whisker Row: a cosy animal-town business sim I’m building with two AI agents (first trailer)
author: Altruistic_Car_1868
selftext:
Here’s the first trailer for Whisker Row. You move into a little town of cats, dogs, foxes, bears and rabbits and try to build a shop empire.

In my hometown there is a cat that lives in a shopping street that goes inside of shops and hangs out/sleeps there. In my mind she manages these shops. This was my inspiration!

**What you do**  
Design your character and do up your house  
Buy lots, build shops and run them: stock, prices, staff, upgrades  
Take on rival businesses by buying them out or playing dirty  
Trade riskier goods after dark, as long as you can outrun the police  
Play mini-games around town

**How it’s made**  
**Code:** Claude Code is the lead developer, and ChatGPT works alongside it on self-contained parts like audio and content. The two coordinate through a shared task board in the repo, and I direct.  
**Characters:** generated in Meshy, then rigged and animated automatically by a pipeline script.  
**Platforms:** the main build runs on desktop. A Godot port is in progress so it plays on handhelds like the Legion Go.  
**Trailer:** captured from the game by a script, and the music is rendered from the game’s own sound engine.

**I’d love to hear**  
Your first impression from the trailer  
Anything that’s confusing or that you’d expect to see  
If you’ve built with more than one AI agent: how do you stop them stepping on each other’s work?

I don’t have a public demo yet as I am still working on it. But I can send it later to those interested.

comments.author: MrFoxChile
comments.body: Me encanta como estás llevando la creación, ¿no podrías compartir como estás haciendo trabajar dos agentes de IA para el juego? Estoy teniendo problemas para hacer el mío, estoy usando Claude y una repo en Github para el juego que está en código compatible con godot pero es complicado la parte de sonido y animaciones de personajes y entorno.

replies.author: Altruistic_Car_1868
replies.body: I am using Claude Opus 5.5 and Chatgpt Astra to work in the same folder and after each prompt they update a session log file so that when Claude has done something, Astra know what. Also I made astra work on creating models and content while Claude does the coding. But that is just preference. But as you can see i am still generating models with Meshy. That’s why some characters look great while others… well look not so great

replies.author: MrFoxChile
replies.body: Recomiendas meshy es de paga verdad?

replies.author: Altruistic_Car_1868
replies.body: Yes, it’s paid. But good. Then again i didnt try other paid options
